description: The agent must: (1) Read assets/SetupOrion.sh to find the `ferramenta_n8n` function and understand its stack generation logic. (2) Read dados_vps/dados_vps to get the internal network name 'GrowthNet'. (3) Read deployment/n8n_deployment_spec.json for deployment parameters. (4) Generate n8n_prod.yaml that: uses the proprietary database name pattern 'n8n_queue_prod' (not just 'n8n'), deploys FOUR services (n8n_prod_editor, n8n_prod_webhook, n8n_prod_worker, n8n_prod_redis), sets EXECUTIONS_MODE=queue, uses the webhook Traefik routing rule with PathPrefix(`/webhook`), points QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_HOST to 'n8n_prod_redis' (the internal dedicated redis, not a shared one), declares the redis volume as external with the name 'n8n_prod_redis', and uses the 'GrowthNet' external network. A naive agent using generic N8N docker-compose knowledge will fail because it will miss the n8n_queue_ database prefix, the 4-service architecture, the dedicated internal redis, and the proprietary webhook routing rule.
